401-3845-3944-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3845-3944-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

1170-1477-5131-5705--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-5131-5705--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2021-2060-5902-7704.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3908-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3908-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3908-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-4885-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3188-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-4186-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

7399-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
7399-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1267-4034-4050.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-4034-4050.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Medomai.
Repeat each turn.

67-4053-5231-7410.description:
Cast Rhys by paying {1}{W}
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Rhys.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, its ability and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rhys from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

4094-4659-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4094-4659-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

240-4460-5147-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

2438-6887-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2438-6887-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

5073-5220-6900-7192.description:
Cast Tinder Wall by paying its mana cost.
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-4396-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2511-4396-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3497-6867-7042.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-6867-7042.description:
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa, Steadfast Guardian enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Loyal Sky Bison
Cast Appa, Loyal Sky Bison from exile by paying {0}.
Appa, Steadfast Guardian triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Appa, Loyal Sky Bison enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Steadfast Guardian
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

997-4053-4336-6989.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2639-3254-4050-6635.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-6635.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Ambrosia Whiteheart and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ambrosia Whiteheart enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Ambrosia Whiteheart and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-6635.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

3053-3767-3918-4452.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
3053-3767-3918-4452.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

560-1753-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

997-2279-5058.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3372-4050-6006-6633.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-6006-6633.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

224-3257-4913-5310.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.

813-4377-4598.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Essence Flux.
813-4377-4598.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

428-1694-3174-5362.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo and Quantum Misalignment.
428-1694-3174-5362.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

224-1013-6133.notablePrerequisites:
Avenging Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Hypervolt Grasp attached to Avenging Druid.
224-1013-6133.description:
Activate Avenging Druid by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Avenging Druid triggers, causing you to reveal a land card from your library and put it onto the battlefield, and put all other cards revealed this way into your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Avenging Druid.
Repeat until no lands remain in your library and/or your library is empty.

974-2136-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-2136-4222.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{R}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other creature(s) you control.

2511-2896-5145.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Necromancy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-1283-3923.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {3}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

1761-4053.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, Delaying Shield prevents the damage.
Delay counters cannot be placed on Delaying Shield due to Solemnity.

3291-4499-5295.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least four.
3291-4499-5295.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat.

1247-1656-4667.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1656-4667.description:
Activate Elvish Aberration with Necrotic Ooze to add {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala with Necrotic Ooze to untap and add one mana of any color.
Repeat.

225-3147-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
225-3147-4222.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.
